question: Who is the High Commissioner of India to Bangladesh as of June 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Riva Ganguly Das**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Riva Ganguly Das is an Indian** diplomat** who belongs to the Indian Foreign Service.
 
• She is the **former High Commissioner of India to Bangladesh and former Director-General of the Indian **Council for Cultural Relations.
 
• **Bangladesh**__
 __
 
• Capital: Dhaka
 
• Currency: Taka
 
• Prime Minister: Sheikh Hasina
 
• President: Abdul Hamid
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​Current High Commissioner of India to Bangladesh: **Vikram Doraiswami.**
 
• Current High Commissioner of Bangladesh to India:** Muhammad Imran.**
